About the function
A job is to operate a CNC Daewoo/Puma 240 lathe with a Fanuc control system. 
The main tasks include setting up, operating, and monitoring the CNC machine, machining metal components (mainly steel and stainless steel) according to technical drawings and tolerances, and performing quality checks using standard measuring tools (caliper, micrometer, etc.).
The operator will be responsible for changing tools, loading and adjusting programs in the Fanuc control when necessary, and reporting any deviations or technical issues to the supervisor.
About the company
A specialist in process technology with decades of experience delivering fully integrated systems for handling powders, granules, and pellets. Known for in-house engineering, high efficiency, and solutions tailored to the food, feed, dairy, and chemical industries. Recognized for innovation, reliability, and end-to-end control.

Experience with CNC turning and Fanuc, experience with work in a similar environment is a plus. Speaking English (B1 level), reading technical drawings is a must.

Our client is a leading international retail organization operating across multiple countries. This company is investing heavily in the modernization and optimization of its technology landscape, with SAP playing a central role in supporting business operations and future growth.

As part of its ongoing digital transformation journey, the organization is strengthening its SAP Retail team to enhance business processes, improve operational efficiency, and support strategic initiatives across procurement, supply chain, inventory management, pricing, and store operations.

As IT SAP Retail Consultant, you will join a team of experienced professionals working closely with stakeholders across business and IT functions to deliver impactful solutions that support the organization's long-term ambitions.

As Senior SAP Retail Business Consultant, you will be responsible for supporting, optimizing, and evolving SAP Retail solutions across the end-to-end retail value chain.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Supporting and enhancing SAP Retail business processes across procurement, inventory management, assortment management, pricing, replenishment, logistics, and store operations.
• Gathering business requirements and translating them into functional specifications and effective SAP solutions.
• Configuring SAP Retail functionalities and ensuring alignment with SAP best practices.
• Driving process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives across business units and countries.
• Providing 2nd and 3rd line functional support, investigating incidents, identifying root causes, and coordinating issue resolution.
• Contributing to SAP transformation and S/4HANA-related projects by participating in workshops, solution design activities, testing, and deployment initiatives.
• Collaborating with business users, project teams, implementation partners, and external service providers.
• Supporting system integrations with eCommerce platforms, warehouse management solutions, financial applications, POS systems, EDI interfaces, and other third-party solutions.
• Assisting data migration activities and promoting data quality and governance best practices.
• Acting as a trusted advisor for business stakeholders while mentoring junior team members and facilitating knowledge transfer.
• Ensuring the stability, performance, and long-term sustainability of SAP Retail solutions

To succeed in this role, you will combine strong SAP Retail expertise with excellent stakeholder management and problem-solving capabilities.

You ideally bring:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related field.
• At least 8 years of SAP experience, including a minimum of 5 years focused on SAP Retail.
• Proven experience working within large-scale retail organizations and complex international environments.
• Strong expertise in:
• SAP Retail
• SAP MM
• SAP SD
• Assortment Management
• Article Master Data
• Purchasing Processes
• Inventory Management
• Invoice Verification
• Retail Pricing
• Exposure to SAP S/4HANA Retail, SAP CAR, SAP Datasphere, SAP BTP, or SAP Integration Suite would be considered a strong advantage.
• Solid understanding of retail and supply chain business processes.
• Experience in solution design, requirements gathering, testing, and change management.
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
• Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
• The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
• Fluency in English and either French or Dutch.

Responsibilities

• Manage the end-to-end delivery of strategic BI and Data Analytics projects, including migrations and improvement tracks.
• Act as the bridge between business departments, IT teams, and external suppliers to ensure alignment with project scope and quality expectations.
• Oversee the development of reporting solutions with a specific focus on ESG/CSRD compliance and organizational KPI requirements.
• Drive project delivery using Agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban while maintaining focus on solution-delivery ownership.
• Lead collaboration with Data Governance, Architecture, and Engineering teams to build a consistent and future-proof data environment.
• Document essential project artifacts including charters, roadmaps, migration plans, and architecture guidelines.

Requirements

• You have 8+ years of experience as a Project Manager with a hands-on approach to delivery.
• You possess 5+ years of experience in the delivery of Data & Analytics related projects.
• You bring proven expertise in BI tools including Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and Microsoft Azure.
• You have a strong background in Agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban.
• You possess a degree in Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.
• You have experience using JIRA and Confluence for project tracking and documentation.

Nice to Haves

• Experience in creating migration plans and documenting architecture best practices.

Responsibilities

Lead Solution Architect - Technical Lead

Location: Brussels
Work model: 2 days/week onsite
Contract: Long-term freelance assignment
Language: French + English OR Dutch + English

 

I'm currently looking for a Lead Solution Architect to join the architecture team of a large organisation in the public sector.

This is not a standard Solution Architect position.

You will become the technical reference for a team of 8-9 experienced Solution Architects, taking the lead on architectural decisions while remaining close enough to the technology and development teams to challenge technical choices, review solutions and provide hands-on architectural guidance.

The organisation is looking for someone who can combine deep technical expertise with strong leadership and communication skills - someone who can challenge experienced architects and developers, but also confidently defend architectural decisions at Board and business level.

Your role

As Lead Solution Architect, you will:

• Act as the technical reference point for the architecture team.
• Take the lead on complex architectural decisions and defend them towards the Architecture Board and business stakeholders.
• Define, evolve and enforce architectural principles, standards and best practices.
• Challenge architectural choices made across multiple projects and Scrum teams.
• Support Solution Architects in solving complex technical and architectural problems.
• Participate in architecture reviews and contribute to the organisation's technology roadmap.
• Work closely with development teams and remain technically credible with senior developers and technical leads.
• Review technical designs and, where relevant, participate in code reviews.
• Guide teams through technology choices, integration patterns, security considerations and architectural trade-offs.
• Provide architectural leadership across a combination of legacy modernisation and new technology initiatives.
• Act as a natural leader within the architecture community, without direct people-management responsibility.
 

Your background

We're looking for a very senior Solution Architect with a strong technical foundation and the maturity to operate at both technical and strategic level.

You ideally bring:

• Significant experience in Solution Architecture / Software Architecture.
• A strong technical background in Java, ideally within large and complex environments.
• Good understanding of Angular / modern application architectures.
• Strong knowledge of application integration and security.
• Experience working with both legacy environments and modern architectures.
• Experience in large-scale, multi-project organisations.
• The ability to challenge technical decisions and communicate complex subjects clearly.
• Experience interacting with senior management, architecture boards or business stakeholders.
• The credibility to work directly with experienced developers, technical leads and other architects.
• Strong leadership and influencing skills, without necessarily having formal management responsibility.
• Excellent English communication skills. French or Dutch is a plus.
The person

The ideal candidate is someone who is already considered a technical reference by the people around them.

You don't necessarily need to be the person with the biggest title in the room. You need to be the person others turn to when an architectural problem becomes difficult.

You are comfortable moving between:

Developer → Architect → Architecture Board → Business

without losing credibility at any level.

This is a long-term freelance opportunity for an architect looking to take on a high-impact technical leadership role within a complex organisation.

Own critical network infrastructure, work with modern technologies and shape the evolution of IT within a stable, people-focused organisation.

Our partner is a well-established Belgian organisation operating across multiple locations, with a strong focus on service, reliability and digital transformation. Its IT environment supports a broad network of sites and business operations, making availability, security and connectivity essential to its day-to-day activities.

 

As part of a growing IT Infrastructure team, you will join an environment where networking is not simply about keeping systems running: you will have the opportunity to take ownership, work on infrastructure projects and influence how the network evolves.
Network Engineer | The Role
As a Network Engineer, you will take an active role in the operational management and continuous improvement of the organisation's network environment.

• Manage and monitor LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN and firewall infrastructure across multiple locations.
• Troubleshoot complex network incidents, identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
• Work closely with external technology partners, coordinating their activities and challenging proposed solutions when needed.
• Contribute to network projects, migrations, upgrades and standardisation, while ensuring smooth change management.
• Proactively monitor performance, availability and security, using KPIs and monitoring tools to prevent service degradation and downtime.
• Contribute to automation, security and infrastructure improvements, with opportunities to expand into areas such as cloud, systems or cybersecurity.
Network Engineer | The Profile
We are looking for a technically strong Network Engineer who enjoys ownership, problem-solving and working across a broader infrastructure environment.

• 2+ years of experience in Network Engineering, Systems Engineering or IT Infrastructure.
• Solid knowledge of routing, switching, VLANs, Wi-Fi, WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP and network segmentation.
• Experience with network monitoring, incident management, troubleshooting and change management.
• Familiarity with technologies such as Cisco, Meraki, firewalls, SD-WAN or Network Access Control is a strong plus.
• Interest in automation and scripting using technologies such as PowerShell, Python, Ansible or APIs.
• Fluent in Dutch or French, professionally proficient in the other national language, with a good command of English.
